item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Hegseth Says U.S. Is Poised to Resume Combat if Talks Fail
item.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth urged Iran’s leaders to “choose wisely” and said a U.S. blockade of Iranian ports would continue “as long as it takes.”

item.title: Russian Strikes Kill at Least 15 in Ukraine in Biggest Attack in Months
item.summary: Moscow is again ramping up missile and drone attacks on civilian targets, dispelling any notion that a temporary cease-fire for Orthodox Easter might become more lasting.

item.title: Pope Leo, Amid Standoff With Trump, Says ‘Blessed Are the Peacemakers’
item.summary: For days, Pope Leo XIV has attracted criticism from President Trump and his allies for refusing to back the war in Iran. On Thursday, he reiterated his calls for peace.

item.title: With Iran War on Pause, Political Battle Resumes Over Israeli Democracy
item.summary: A court fight over Itamar Ben-Gvir, an extremist who oversees the police, pits the attorney general against Benjamin Netanyahu and his right-wing government.

item.title: Sri Lanka Uses U.S.-Iran Cease-Fire to Repatriate Iranian Sailors
item.summary: Sri Lanka had been refusing to send back the Iranian Navy personnel, including survivors from a warship that the United States torpedoed, during active hostilities.

item.title: Trump Says Leaders From Israel and Lebanon Will Speak Thursday
item.summary: Neither side confirmed a meeting. Israeli and Lebanese officials have said a cease-fire in the war against Hezbollah is under consideration.

item.title: 3 Killed in Boat Strike in the Pacific, Pentagon Says
item.summary: It was the third such attack by the U.S. military in three days, and the 51st attack in a campaign against people who the United States has accused of smuggling drugs.

item.title: Got $100 Million? Ukraine Has Just the Fertilizer Plant for You.
item.summary: An effort to privatize the facility is a key test of whether Kyiv can overcome concerns about Russian attacks and corruption to attract foreign investment.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Pakistan Looks to Play Peacemaker Between U.S. and Iran, Again
item.summary: After talks in Islamabad last weekend led to a two-week cease-fire, Pakistan is offering to host another round in an attempt to sustain ongoing peace efforts.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] South African Politician Julius Malema Is Sentenced to 5 Years in Prison
item.summary: The leftist lawmaker has been a prime target of President Trump’s attacks on South Africa. The ruling, handed down after a conviction on gun charges, leaves Mr. Malema’s political future in doubt.
